name: marimo-wallpaper
description: Marimo (hairy ball) wallpaper for Wallpaper Engine — recreated in Three.js. No bundler required.
//: There is no build step. All source files are loaded as classic <script> tags so the wallpaper runs directly from index.html via file:// or any static server. `npm run dev` is purely a convenience for browser testing — Wallpaper Engine itself never needs Node.
